programme.title: The Curse Of the King Tut
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, the great Child King Tutankhamen ruled. Few know the details of his life no one knows the secrets of his death. But all is about to change. In 1922 Cairo, free-spirited archaeologist Danny Fremont is certain that if found, King Tut's Emerald Tablet would hold the ultimate power to control the world. But unfortunately, the only person who believes Fremont is his ruthless archaeologist nemesis Morgan Sinclair, a member of a secret society who wants the tablet to harness unspeakable evil on the world and will stop at nothing to get it and then extend their world domination. But with the help of a crackerjack team adventurers that includes the doubting egyptologist Dr. Azelia Barakat, Fremont ventures through the Valley of the Kings, toward Tut's tomb, near the portal to the underworld, and getting closer to the truth behind a mystery that will change the world forever or end it.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. „Barcelona“ - Madrido „Real“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Dubai - Crvena Zvezda
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Stambulo „Anadolu Efes“ - Milano "EA7 Emporio Armani"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: At zero degrees latitude, the equator is the imaginary line that runs across the middle of our spheroid planet, passing through 13 countries that are home to diverse and wild ecosystems. In this six-part documentary series, we explore a wonderful natural area in each episode, revealing its stunning and unique wildlife. The team travel to the Galapagos islands, the Andes mountains, the Amazon rainforest, Africa, Borneo and Sumatra, and the coral seas that thrive off the abundant, equatorial sunlight, showcasing the vastly contrasting environments that are dotted along the equator.

programme.title: Wild India

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol Compilations
programme.desc: There's not much that Dr. Jan Pol hasn't seen throughout his long, veterinarian career. The Dutch-born veterinarian has been helping animals since he graduated from Utrecht University in 1970. In this series we look back at memorable moments from his reality series, The Incredible Dr. Pol, where alongside his employees and his family he helps nurse a variety of creatures back to health from his Michigan-based practice. His clients come in all shapes and sizes, often needing urgent medical assistance, something that Dr. Jan Pol lives for. The passionate veterinarian is always keen to help, and we revisit the original series' greatest moments.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly

programme.title: Hidden Wonders of Europe

programme.title: Africa's Wild Geniuses
programme.desc: Africa, with its diverse ecosystems from arid deserts to lush forests, is home to some remarkable wild geniuses. While these outliers may not be the strongest, they compensate with their wit. They deploy adaptive strategies and surprising maneuvers to survive against all odds. In the desert, meerkats teach their young to communicate while the caracal uses adaptations to hunt elusive prey, and the wheel spider uses its engineering skills to ride the dunes. In the savannah, the secretarybird cares for her chicks; the dung beetle navigates obstacles; and the Thomson's gazelle relies on keen instinct. In the Highlands, gelada monkeys choose leaders to maintain social order, and the Ethiopian wolf uses clever tricks to feed her cubs. In the forest, the aye-aye and chameleon use their supernatural skills to forage the forest.

programme.desc: Germany is Europe's most populous nation. A land hewn by mighty rivers and cloaked in forest. In these wild spaces, nature is full of surprises. From the Bavarian mountains to the North Sea, over a third of the country is now protected. Huge Grey Seals battle to breed, Marmots and Squirrels flee aerial invaders, and elusive Lynx and Moose - once hunted out - re-assert their grip.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Geniuses
programme.desc: Africa, with its diverse ecosystems from arid deserts to lush forests, is home to some remarkable wild geniuses. While these outliers may not be the strongest, they compensate with their wit. They deploy adaptive strategies and surprising maneuvers to survive against all odds. In the desert, meerkats teach their young to communicate while the caracal uses adaptations to hunt elusive prey, and the wheel spider uses its engineering skills to ride the dunes. In the savannah, the secretarybird cares for her chicks; the dung beetle navigates obstacles; and the Thomson's gazelle relies on keen instinct. In the Highlands, gelada monkeys choose leaders to maintain social order, and the Ethiopian wolf uses clever tricks to feed her cubs. In the forest, the aye-aye and chameleon use their supernatural skills to forage the forest.

programme.title: Built to Survive

He encounters a feisty mud crab with huge pincers and catches a shovel-nosed ray with his bare hands. Finally, Phil faces a creature we all love to hate—the mosquito—and discovers there's more to these tiny bloodsuckers than meets the eye.

programme.title: Built to Survive

programme.title: The Casagrandes

Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Nuts to You/The Terror of Madagascar Description : Nuts to You: Fred the Squirrel has hit the jackpot. He stumbles onto a jackpot oak tree which is loaded with acorns (that's tons of money to animal folk). He's going to need financial advice, and who better to offer sound advice than King Julien? The two enter a partnership looking for ways to spend on the good life. The Red Squirrel has designs on the loot, though, and captures the hapless twosome in order to squeeze the acorns out of them. Will the evil squirrel's precisely planned plot pay or get him played? The Terror of Madagascar: A special delivery has come from Madagascar. What is it? A baby Fossa! Everyone is enchanted by the little tyke except King Julien, who sees him as a lemur-devouring predator, and he has the toothmarks on his butt to prove it! Julien formulates a plan to get rid of the adorable little carnivore, but his slithery solution becomes much worse than the problem!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Laid Plaintains: It's a special day when Bada and Bing get a shipment of delicious plantains to eat. Although they jealously guard the African bananas, King Julien's determined to taste them too. He sneaks into the gorilla habitat while they sleep, and he and Marlene end up eating a few too many for the gorillas not to notice. Like all of them. When they realize what they've done they head for the hills as fast as their stolen car can take them. Can the penguins calm the savage beasts before they bash the banana bandits? P.E.L.T.: Skipper's losing it. His performance on the obstacle course is actually slowing down, so he has to trigger a special fitness test to prove he can still lead the squad. Kowalski takes over as Skipper excuses himself to go on his fitness quest. The brainy bird appears to do a bang-up job in the leadership role - are Skipper's days at the helm over but he's too chicken to admit it?

programme.title: L'ultimo giorno sulla Terra
programme.desc: Sci-fi movie con Jean Reno e Hugo Becker, opera prima di Romain Quirot. 2050: un planetoide ha desertificato il globo e ora sta per distruggerlo. Paul e' l'unico astronauta che puo' fermarlo.

programme.title: Ore 15:17 - Attacco al treno
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood affronta la piaga del terrorismo dirigendo un dramma tratto da una storia vera, interpretata dagli eroi che l'hanno realmente vissuta. Spencer Stone, Alek Skarlatos e Anthony Sadler sono tre ragazzi di Sacramento, amici di lunga data, che stanno passando le vacanze in giro per l'Europa. E il 21 agosto del 2015 si trovano a bordo del treno Thalys 9364 diretto da Amsterdam a Parigi. Il treno, con a bordo circa 500 passeggeri, è anche l'obiettivo dell'Isis, ma saranno proprio Spencer, Alek e Anthony a sventare l'attentato, trasformandosi da persone comuni a eroi.

programme.title: Nowhere Special - Una storia d'amore
programme.desc: Uberto Pasolini dirige un film struggente con James Norton e Daniel Lamont. Affetto da una malattia incurabile, John vuole trovare una famiglia per suo figlio di quattro anni.

programme.title: La sfida delle mogli
programme.desc: Peter Cattaneo ("Full Monty") dirige un biopic al femminile con Kristin Scott Thomas. Per sopportare l'assenza dei mariti in missione in Afghanistan, alcune donne formano un coro musicale.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.title: Senza sangue
programme.desc: Angelina Jolie dirige Salma Hayek in un intenso dramma ispirato al romanzo di Alessandro Baricco. Una donna ritrova dopo anni uno dei responsabili del massacro della sua famiglia e deve decidere come sia giusto vendicarsi.

programme.title: Mrs Lowry & Son
programme.desc: Timothy Spall e Vanessa Redgrave nella biografia del pittore britannico L. S. Lowry. Figlio di una donna che scoraggia quotidianamente le sue ambizioni, l’aspirante artista lavora ogni giorno con l’obiettivo di dipingere un quadro che possa rendere la madre fiera di lui.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: 6 Oscar per il capolavoro di Kathryn Bigelow con Jeremy Renner protagonista. In Iraq, una squadra di artificieri statunitensi viene inviata sul posto per una pericolosa missione.

programme.title: L'ultimo giorno sulla Terra
programme.desc: Sci-fi movie con Jean Reno e Hugo Becker, opera prima di Romain Quirot. 2050: un planetoide ha desertificato il globo e ora sta per distruggerlo. Paul e' l'unico astronauta che puo' fermarlo.

programme.title: Babygirl
programme.desc: Coppa Volpi a Venezia a Nicole Kidman in un dramma erotico con Harris Dickinson e Antonio Banderas. Una donna sposata, amministratice delegata di un'azienda importante, inizia una relazione clandestina con un giovane stagista che la trascina in una spirale di perversione.

programme.title: Boogie Nights - L'altra Hollywood
programme.desc: Paul Thomas Anderson firma l'epopea di un promettente pornoattore, interpretato da Mark Wahlberg, sullo sfondo dei trasgressivi anni 70. Nel cast Heather Graham e Julianne Moore.

programme.title: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
programme.desc: Ricatti e omicidi in un thriller con Val Kilmer, Robert Downey Jr e Michelle Monaghan. Una serie di coincidenze porta un ladro a recitare in un film. Finirà in un torbido giro.

programme.title: Starman
programme.desc: Il docufilm di Gianluca Cerasola dedicato a Luca Parmitano, il primo astronauta italiano a diventare comandante della ISS e a battere il record di permanenza extraveicolare nello Spazio.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Questo o quello.

programme.title: Maria
programme.desc: Angelina Jolie è l'indimenticabile diva del 900 Maria Callas nel biopic di Pablo Larrain con Pierfrancesco Favino e Alba Rohrwacher. Parigi, 1977: ormai da anni lontana dalle scene, la celebre soprano ripercorre la propria vita, segnata dalla gloria e dai tormenti.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Chris Hemsworth e Daniel Bruhl nel biopic sulla rivalita' fra i piloti James Hunt e Niki Lauda, protagonisti di una memorabile stagione della Formula Uno.

programme.title: Napoli - New York
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores dirige Pierfrancesco Favino in un dramma tratto da un soggetto di Federico Fellini e Tullio Pinelli. Napoli, 1949: con la speranza di ritrovare la sorella, l'orfanella Celestina si imbarca da clandestina con l'amico Carmine su una nave per New York.

programme.title: Moglie e marito
programme.desc: Fioccano gli equivoci nella commedia con Pierfrancesco Favino e Kasia Smutniak. Andrea e' un affermato neurochirurgo, sua moglie Sofia una conduttrice televisiva: sono sposati, hanno due figli ma il loro rapporto attraversa una crisi nera. Non riescono proprio a capire le reciproche difficolta', almeno fino a quando non ci mette lo zampino il destino: un esperimento scientifico riuscito male scaraventa l'uno nel corpo dell'altra innescando una serie di momenti imbarazzanti ma molto divertenti. Andrea e Sofia scopriranno nella pratica cosa significa vivere nei panni del partner.

programme.title: Suburra
programme.desc: Pierfrancesco Favino, Elio Germano, Claudio Amendola e Alessandro Borghi nel noir di Stefano Sollima. Tra corruzione dilagante e malavita si consuma la feroce lotta per il potere a Roma.

programme.title: A casa tutti bene
programme.desc: Piefrancesco Favino e Stefano Accorsi nel film corale di Gabriele Muccino. Gli equilibri di una famiglia si sfaldano durante un soggiorno forzato su un'isola del Mediterraneo.

programme.title: Il traditore
programme.desc: Marco Bellocchio dirige Pierfrancesco Favino nella biografia del 'boss dei due mondi', Tommaso Buscetta, il primo pentito della mafia, che testimonio' nel maxiprocesso contro Cosa Nostra.

programme.title: Corro da te
programme.desc: Riccardo Milani dirige Pierfrancesco Favino e Miriam Leone in una commedia brillante e dissacrante. Gianni e' un seduttore seriale, ma l'incontro con Chiara cambiera' tutto.

programme.title: Padrenostro
programme.desc: Coppa Volpi a Pierfrancesco Favino, diretto da Claudio Noce in una storia ispirata alla sua vita. Roma, 1976: Valerio assiste all'attentato terroristico ai danni del padre magistrato.

programme.title: A.C.A.B.
programme.desc: Pierfrancesco Favino, Marco Giallini e Filippo Nigro nella pellicola di Stefano Sollima. Reduci dal G8 di Genova, 3 celerini affrontano l'odio dei cittadini e una vita privata allo sbando.

programme.title: Le confessioni
programme.desc: Toni Servillo e Pierfrancesco Favino nella pellicola di Roberto Ando'. In un albergo di lusso sta per riunirsi il G8 dei ministri dell'economia per decidere il futuro del mondo occidentale.

programme.title: Aprile
programme.desc: Nanni Moretti dirige e interpreta una commedia pungente che e' insieme opera autobiografica e resoconto critico delle vicende politiche, dalla primavera del 1994 all’estate del 1997.

programme.title: Ariaferma
programme.desc: Toni Servillo e Silvio Orlando nel dramma carcerario di Leonardo Di Costanzo che indaga il delicato rapporto tra secondini e detenuti, premiato con 2 David di Donatello 2022.

programme.title: L'arminuta
programme.desc: 1 David di Donatello al film di Giuseppe Bonito dal bestseller di Donatella Di Pietrantonio. Una tredicenne torna dalla sua famiglia biologica, passando da una vita agiata alla poverta'.

programme.title: Mystic River
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Penn e Tim Robbins, in un capolavoro di Clint Eastwood. L'omicidio di una ragazza riporta alla luce un caso di pedofilia che coinvolse tre bambini di Boston.

programme.title: La La Land
programme.desc: 6 Oscar al musical di Damien Chazelle con Ryan Gosling ed Emma Stone, premiata a Venezia. Mia, aspirante attrice, s'innamora di Sebastian, pianista jazz che sogna di aprire un night club.

programme.title: The Apprentice - Alle origini di Trump
programme.desc: Sebastian Stan è l’imprenditore e Presidente USA nel biopic di Ali Abbasi. New York, anni 70: l'ascesa del magnate segnata dall'incontro con l'avvocato Roy Cohn (Jeremy Strong).

programme.title: Un eroe
programme.desc: Grand Prix della Giuria a Cannes per il pluripremiato Asghar Farhadi. Un detenuto rinuncia a una borsa piena d'oro restituendola al proprietario. Diventera' un eroe ma con esiti imprevisti.

programme.title: Conclave
programme.desc: Un Oscar e un Golden Globe all'acclamato film di Edward Berger ambientato nel mondo della Chiesa con Ralph Fiennes, Stanley Tucci, Sergio Castellitto e Isabella Rossellini.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: 6 Oscar a una commedia cult degli anni 90, con Tom Hanks per la regia di Robert Zemeckis. Le incredibili vicende di un uomo ingenuo ma ottimista sullo sfondo di 30 anni di storia americana.

programme.title: Io sono ancora qui
programme.desc: Walter Salles dirige Fernanda Torres in una storia vera premiata a Venezia e con l'Oscar 2025. Brasile, 1971: un giorno, all'improvviso, Rubens Paiva viene prelevato da casa.

programme.title: Per niente al mondo
programme.desc: Guido Caprino prova a riprendere in mano la sua vita nel film di Ciro D'Emilio. La vita di Bernardo cambia drasticamente quando viene incarcerato con l'accusa di associazione a delinquere.

programme.title: Laggiù qualcuno mi ama
programme.desc: Ritratto di Massimo Troisi in un documentario di Mario Martone. Le tante sfaccettature dell'indimenticato artista partenopeo attraverso materiali inediti e testimonianze di chi lo ha amato.

programme.desc: Il prequel totalmente animato della saga sci-fi e' un'origin story che narra l'amicizia dei futuri nemici giurati Optimus Prime e Megatron, in fuga dalla Cyberton sotterranea, e il momento in cui acquisiscono i loro poteri.

programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf e Megan Fox nel primo capitolo della saga sci-fi prodotta da Steven Spielberg. Due razze aliene, gli Autobots e i Decepticons, scelgono la Terra come campo di battaglia.

programme.desc: Michael Bay dirige Shia LaBeouf e John Turturro nel terzo capitolo della saga prodotta da Steven Spielberg. Gli Autobot devono difendersi dai Decepticons e da un nuovo terribile nemico.

programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg e Anthony Hopkins nel quinto capitolo della saga diretta da Michael Bay. Un'inaspettata alleanza e' l'unica possibilita' per salvare la Terra da una minaccia spaziale.

programme.desc: Taron Egerton, Ansel Elgort e Kevin Spacey nella storia di una truffa finanziaria. Anni '80: Joe Hunt escogita un modello economico che garantisce soldi facili; ma la situazione precipita.

programme.title: L'inferno di cristallo
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al film precursore del genere catastrofico con Paul Newman e Steve McQueen. L'inaugurazione di un grattacielo a San Francisco rischia di trasformarsi in tragedia.

programme.title: Nodo alla gola
programme.desc: Dopo aver compiuto un omicidio due amici danno una cena sicuri di non venire scoperti. Ma tra gli invitati qualcuno sospetta di loro. Straordinario esercizio di stile del re del brivido: un film girato in un unico piano sequenza.

programme.title: Out of Sight
programme.desc: George Clooney e Jennifer Lopez in un thriller di Steven Soderbergh, tratto da un romanzo di Elmore Leonard. Un rapinatore gentiluomo evade dal carcere e prende in ostaggio una poliziotta.

programme.title: Questo o quello: Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova raccontano i film della collezione dedicata a Gerard Butler, disponibile su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: Morgan Freeman e Antonio Banderas in un thriller mozzafiato. Un esperto ladro internazionale recluta un giovane 'collega' per mettere a segno l'ultimo colpo della sua carriera.

programme.desc: Intrighi da Guerra Fredda nello spy-thriller di Alfred Hitchcock. Un agente segreto francese, in missione per conto della Cia, scopre l'esistenza di missili sovietici a Cuba.

programme.title: Manhattan Nocturne
programme.desc: Palpitante thriller con Adrien Brody. Un giornalista newyorkese sprofonda in un vortice di pericoli mortali quando un'attraente sconosciuta lo convince ad indagare sull'omicidio del marito.

programme.title: Scomparsa
programme.desc: Amanda Seyfried a caccia dell'assassino in un thriller psicologico. Tornata a casa dal lavoro Jill scopre che sua sorella, Molly, e' stata rapita. Come poteva accadere a lei un anno prima, quando riusci' a fuggire dal misterioso aggressore che adesso sembra tornato in azione. Gia', perche' Jill e' convinta che dietro la scomparsa della sorella ci sia la stessa persona. Considerata paranoica dalla polizia, Jill non ha altra scelta per uscire da quest'incubo: indagare da sola per trovare il rapitore di sua sorella prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.desc: Patrick Wilson e Vera Farmiga nel primo capitolo della saga horror su una coppia di indagatori dell'occulto, che entrano in azione per fermare una terribile strega nel New England degli anni 70. La famiglia Perron - padre, madre e cinque figlie femmine - si e' appena trasferita in una nuova casa in campagna dove sono stati accolti da rumori inquietanti e strane apparizioni, che ben presto degenerano in vere e proprie manifestazioni paranormali. Terrorizzati, i coniugi Perron chiedono aiuto a due investigatori specializzati nella lotta contro presenze demoniache.

programme.title: Il caso Thomas Crawford

programme.desc: Thriller di Alfred Hitchcock tratto da un romanzo di Patricia Highsmith. Un miliardario incastra un tennista con un diabolico piano.

programme.desc: Natalie Portman in un avvincente horror fantascientifico. Dopo che il marito, rientrato dall'Area X, si ammala gravemente, una biologa si unisce ad una spedizione sul posto in cerca di un'eventuale cura. Cio' che l'aspetta e' qualcosa di mostruoso.

programme.desc: Thriller psicologico con Sarah Paulson e Keira Allen. Costretta su una sedia a rotelle, la giovane Chloe scopre che le amorevoli cure di sua madre nascondono una verita' inaspettata.

programme.desc: Revenge movie targato Sky Original con Colin Morgan, Felicity Jones e Mark Strong. Sopravvissuto all'assassinio della moglie incinta, a un ex paramilitare non resta che la vendetta.

programme.desc: Paolo Virzì dirige Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Fabrizio Bentivoglio e Valeria Golino. Brianza: un incidente mortale segna il destino di due famiglie in un lento riaffiorare di segreti.

programme.title: Io confesso
programme.desc: Montgomery Clift in un thriller giudiziario di Alfred Hitchcock. Accusato di omicidio, un prete si rifiuta di denunciare il vero colpevole per rispettare il segreto confessionale.

programme.desc: Roan Johnson dirige una dark comedy dal ritmo incalzante con Tommaso Ragno e Dario Aita. Roma: costretti dalla pandemia da Covid-19 a una convivenza forzata nell’appartamento che condividono, quattro ragazzi in difficoltà economica saranno travolti da una nefasta spirale di eventi.

programme.title: American Gigolo
programme.desc: Il film cult degli anni '80 che ha consacrato il mito sexy di Richard Gere. Un affascinante gigolo' finisce nei guai quando una delle sue clienti viene ritrovata barbaramente uccisa.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di nero
programme.desc: Tornano Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan nelle avventure sentimental-erotiche tratte dal secondo capitolo della bollente saga letteraria di E. L. James. Christian Grey riesce a riconquistare la fiducia di Anastasia, ma la nuova vita amorosa della coppia sara' minacciata dall'oscuro passato del miliardario, perche' Christian non riesce a disinnescare le sue pulsioni da dominatore. A rendere ancora piu' torbida la situazione ci pensera' l'ingresso in scena di Leila Williams, l'ossessiva ex-fidanzata di Grey, e di Elena Lincoln (Kim Basinger), la donna che inizio' Grey ai piaceri del sadomaso.

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Danny Boyle dirige una romantica commedia scandita dalle note dei Beatles. Dopo un blackout planetario, un musicista scopre di essere l'unico a conoscere le canzoni dei Fab Four.

programme.desc: Dakota Johnson in una pellicola sulla scoperta della sessualità. Dopo una serie di appuntamenti fallimentari con uomini, Lucy realizza che dipende da ciò che vuole veramente.

programme.desc: I nuovi volti, le nuove sfide, i nuovi amori dell’agenzia più esplosiva d’Italia: un divertente dietro le quinte della terza stagione di Call my agent.

programme.desc: Pilar Fogliati e Filippo Scicchitano in una commedia romantica tra le strade di Roma. Un biglietto nella tasca di lui farà trascorrere a due neosposi una movimentata prima notte.

programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sofia Coppola per una raffinata commedia romantica con Bill Murray e Scarlett Johansson. A Tokyo per uno spot, un divo americano in declino farà un incontro speciale.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Meryl Streep e Pierce Brosnan nel musical tratto dalle canzoni degli Abba. Per le sue nozze, Sophie invita tre ex amanti di sua madre, sperando finalmente di scoprire chi e' il padre.

programme.desc: Fausto Brizzi dirige una commedia corale con Claudio Bisio, Nancy Brilli e Alessandro Gassmann. La ricomparsa degli ex mette in crisi il rapporto di sei coppie.

programme.desc: Romantica commedia con Hugh Grant e Drew Barrymore. Un cantante pop degli anni 80 potrebbe tornare al successo componendo un brano per la star del momento. Lo aiutera' una frizzante ragazza.

Brian viene ammesso all'Universita' di Bristol nonostante venga da una famiglia di umili origini. Appassionato di quiz sin da bambino, entra nella cerchia ristretta degli studenti in procinto di partecipare in tv al famoso "University Challenge". Ma alla domanda piu' difficile dovra' rispondere il suo cuore, diviso fra l'avvenente Alice e l'altrettanto affascinante Rebecca. Tratto dal romanzo "Le domande di Brian" di David Nicholls, autore anche della sceneggiatura.

Viviana e Modesto, entrambi sposati e con un figlio a testa, sono amanti clandestini da lungo tempo ma la loro relazione sta diventando sempre più complicata ai limiti dell’esasperazione. Viviana convince quindi Modesto a rivolgersi a un analista, star di una trasmissione televisiva, per cercare un futuro nel loro rapporto. Ma Viviana e Modesto non sono una coppia, almeno ufficialmente. Tratto dall’omonimo romanzo di Diego De Silva, autore della sceneggiatura con il regista Alessio Maria Federici.

programme.desc: 8 Oscar al kolossal di Victor Fleming con Clark Gable e Vivian Leigh. Le tormentate vicende di un affascinante avventuriero e di una fiera ereditiera nell'America della Guerra Civile.

programme.desc: Dall'omonima serie tv di grande successo, i sofisticati intrighi della famiglia Crawley. Gli aristocratici padroni di casa si mobilitano per l'imminente visita dei reali d’Inghilterra.

programme.title: Grease - Brillantina
programme.desc: L'intramontabile musical con John Travolta e Olivia Newton-John. Una high school nell'America degli anni '50 incornicia le vicende amorose fra la romantica Sandy e lo spavaldo Danny Zuko.

programme.desc: Nino Manfredi, Vittorio Gassman e Stefania Sandrelli nel capolavoro di Ettore Scola. La storia di tre amici, ex partigiani, sullo sfondo dell'Italia dal Dopoguerra agli anni 70. Dopo la fine del conflitto Gianni, Antonio e Nicola (Stefano Satta Flores) hanno preso strade diverse: Antonio fa il portantino e Nicola il professore, mentre Gianni è l’unico dei tre che è riuscito a fare carriera. Dopo molti anni, per caso, i tre si incontrano nuovamente. Sceneggiatura dello stesso Scola, con Age & Scarpelli, breve cameo di Vittorio De Sica, scomparso prima dell’uscita del film nelle sale.

programme.title: We Live In Time - Tutto il tempo che abbiamo
programme.desc: Florence Pugh e Andrew Garfield sono i protagonisti di una toccante storia d’amore. Dopo un incidente, Tobias e Almut vivranno un'intensa relazione tra momenti di felicità e dolore.

programme.desc: Miglior regia a Cannes alla pellicola romantica di Tran Anh Hung con Juliette Binoche. Francia, 1885: il sodalizio tra la cuoca Eugenie e il gastronomo Dodin da' vita a piatti stellati.

programme.desc: Elizabeth Banks in un medical-drama dal romanzo di Carl Shuker. La dottoressa Taylor è un rinomato chirurgo che commette un fatale errore durante un'operazione di routine. Isolata dai vertici dell'ospedale, affronta il tracollo della sua vita professionale e privata.

programme.title: Vendetta
programme.desc: Accurata ricostruzione storica in un superbo thriller con Christopher Walken. New Orleans, 1890: un gruppo di immigrati siciliani viene accusato dell'omicidio del capo della polizia.

programme.title: Sari Saring Sine: Hindi Pa Tapos ang Laban
programme.desc: Fernando Poe Jr. stars as Carding Villamar, a city professional who returns to their hometown of Evangelista after learning of his brother's untimely demise. As a series of events unfold, he soon discovers that his brother didn't succumb to a heart attack as he was made to believe. He was shot in cold blood for refusing to sell his land to a powerful congressman. With a town muted and crippled by fear, the congressman's henchmen move unhampered to silence Carding and his brother's orphaned family as well. Big mistake. Armed with only a crusty riffle and a whole ton of rage. Carding sets out to right the wrong and exact vengeance for the murder of his brother. That is, if he survives the hot pursuits of bounty hunters, the militia and the police who are all in the congressman's payroll.

programme.title: Afterife ep 4

programme.title: Da Pers Family ep 26
programme.desc:
A story of a couple who preserves the family 
bakery business legacy from closure. Now the 
couple’s children, volunteers to step in and help the 
business. Are the parents willing to accept change 
and innovations of the new generation?

programme.title: Er S1 19
programme.desc: Mark misdiagnoses a pregnant woman, who returns to the ER shortly afterward. The ER staff works frantically to save Jodi O'Brien and her baby in this Emmy-Award winning episode.Outstanding Episode.

programme.title: Er S1 20
programme.desc: Hathaway's patient believes that he is a werewolf. Ross goes out on a date with Diane Leeds. Lewis impresses the new chairman of the ER, and Greene doesn't. Benton tends to his sick mother.

programme.title: Dial M For Murder
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Grace Kelly and Ray Milland star with Robert Cummings in one of Alfred Hitchcock's greatest thrillers--Dial M for Murder. When playboy tennis pro Tony Wendice (Milland--The Lost Weekend) discovers his rich wife, Margot (Kelly--Rear Window, To Catch a Thief), is having an affair with handsome American Mark Hallidy (Cummings--The Carpetbaggers), he devises an ingenious plot to murder her. But when his scheme takes an unexpected, deadly twist, Tony improvises--implicating Margot for first degree murder in this classic spellbinder.

programme.title: Dirty Harry
programme.desc: In the year 1971, San Francisco faces the terror of a maniac known as Scorpio- who snipes at innocent victims and demands ransom through notes left at the scene of the crime. Inspector Harry Callahan (known as Dirty Harry by his peers through his reputation handling of homicidal cases) is assigned to the case along with his newest partner Inspector Chico Gonzalez to track down Scorpio and stop him. Using humiliation and cat and mouse type of games against Callahan, Scorpio is put to the test with the cop with a dirty attitude.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S5 13
programme.desc: Everything might change when Leonard offers Penny a spur of the moment invitation to a romantic dinner for two on the 100th episode of the series.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S5 14
programme.desc: Leonard and Penny experiment with dating again by \"beta testing\" their relationship, while Raj develops a peculiar relationship with his phone's virtual assistant.

programme.title: Get Smart
programme.desc: Comic superstar Steve Carell takes on the role of Agent Maxwell Smart and Anne Hathaway steps into the shoes of sexy Agent 99 as the two superspies out to save the world from the nefarious forces of KAOS in this romp based on the classic television show created by Mel Brooks and Buck Henry.

programme.title: King Arthur: Legend Of The Sword
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Guy Ritchie brings his dynamic style to the epic fantasy action adventure \"King Arthur: Legend of the Sword.\" Starring Charlie Hunnam in the title role, the film is an iconoclastic take on the classic Excalibur myth, tracing Arthur's journey from the streets to the throne. When the child Arthur's father is murdered, Vortigern (Jude Law), Arthur's uncle, seizes the crown. Robbed of his birthright and with no idea who he truly is, Arthur comes up the hard way in the back alleys of the city. But once he pulls the sword from the stone, his life is turned upside down and he is forced to acknowledge his true legacy...whether he likes it or not.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: A man (Ewan McGregor) living in a futuristic sterile colony begins to question his circumscribed existence when his friend (Scarlett Johansson) is chosen to go to the Island – reportedly the last uncontaminated place on earth.

programme.title: The Mentalist S5 15
programme.desc: Jane and the CBI team investigate the murder of elderly heiress Elise Vogelson (guest star MARIETTE HARTLEY), whose remains are found in the living room of her spooky mansion.

programme.title: The Mentalist S5 16
programme.desc: Lorelei Martins returns, determined to find out if Red John had a role in her sister's death, and Jane is forced to confess to Lisbon his part in Lorelei's prison escape.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S5 15
programme.desc: Sheldon's selfish demands force Leonard to reconsider their friendship. Meanwhile, Howard tries to pick his astronaut nickname. NASA astronaut MIKE MASSIMINO guest stars.

programme.title: Friends S6 6
programme.desc: The guys and the women prepare for big changes in their living arrangements. Monica and Rachel reminisce – and it's not all good memories.

programme.title: Friends S6 7
programme.desc: Chandler learns how obsessively neat Monica is when he attempts to do her a favor. Joey desperately tries not to flirt with his sexy new roommate. Phoebe's running style embarrasses Rachel.

programme.title: Friends S6 8
programme.desc: Suave Joey is as confident as usual while preparing to make love with Rachel for the first time. Ross goes to a spray-on tanning salon but fails to follow the simple directions properly.

programme.title: Friends S6 9
programme.desc: On Thanksgiving, Chandler tries to gain favor with Monica's parents – but an old secret involving Ross causes problems. Undomestic Rachel's dessert proves intriguing.

programme.title: Friends S6 10
programme.desc: Joey plots the perfect opportunity to kiss Janine on a televised New Year's Eve dance show. Ross and Monica resurrect their dorky high school dance routine for the broadcast.

programme.title: Hack My Life S3 11
programme.desc: Brooke and Kevin head to the casino to see if they can game the system with a high stakes dice-throwing hack, and they test some surprising hacks for overcoming snoring and sleeping through the night.

programme.title: Hack My Life S3 12
programme.desc: Brooke and Kevin explore hacks that could save money on your cable bill, and Hack Master Kosta Grammatis helps Kevin fulfill his childhood laser-blast dreams. Plus, there's an ancient Egyptian hack!

programme.title: Hack My Life S3 13
programme.desc: Kevin and Brooke are having dinner in a hot tub… yup, it's exactly what you think. And it's a blast from the past as Kevin re-hacks a self-tanner. Plus, in the new Saved by the Hacks, our teens have let the hacks take over.

programme.title: Hack My Life S3 14
programme.desc: Brooke and Kevin learn ways to game the system with parking, and the Lazy Cook returns with a recipe for bringing old mac and cheese back to life. Plus, Senora is not the portrait of good behavior in a new Hacks Del Corazon.

programme.title: Hack My Life S3 15
programme.desc: Brooke meets a dominatrix who wants to teach a pomegranate a lesson, and Mack and Jack try to help a new couple beat the cohabitation curse. Plus, Kevin and Brooke test a hack that puts your baby to work.

programme.title: Hack My Life S3 16
programme.desc: Have Kevin and Brooke finally found the hacked pool of their dreams in \"Hack or Wack\"? And in \"Hack Line of Defense,\" rude teenagers will no longer spoil the mood, thanks to hacks that will keep them on the straight and narrow.

programme.title: The Fresh Prince Of Bel-Air S1 2
programme.desc: Ashley's father wants her to continue with her violin lessons, but Will has other ideas.

programme.title: The Fresh Prince Of Bel-Air S1 3
programme.desc: Will wants to go out with a beautiful girl he meets at the country club, but first he must figure out how to impress her extremely snobbish and very protective father.

programme.title: The Fresh Prince Of Bel-Air S1 4
programme.desc: When Philip's parents visit from North Carolina, they embarrass him with stories of his poor rural background and his pet pig.

programme.title: The Fresh Prince Of Bel-Air S1 5
programme.desc: A shady character named \"Ice Tray\" (guest star Don Cheadle – \"Ocean's Thirteen\"), one of Will's friends from Philadelphia, comes to Bel-Air for a visit.

programme.title: The Fresh Prince Of Bel-Air S1 6
programme.desc: Will and Carlton are arrested and accused of committing a string of auto thefts.

programme.title: The Wrong Man
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Henry Fonda stars in director Alfred Hitchcock's real-life thriller of an innocent man trapped as the victim of a heartless criminal justice system--even though he's The Wrong Man. When an eyewitness to a robbery identifies musician Christopher Balestrero (Fonda) as the culprit, Balestrero cannot prove where he was on the day of the crime. Now, the wheels of justice--driven by the testimony of witnesses--mercilessly grind away the life of a man who looks remarkably like the real thief. Based on the novel The True Story of Christopher Emmanuel Balestrero by Maxwell Anderson.

programme.title: Barry Lyndon
programme.desc: Forced to leave Ireland after killing an English officer in a duel, handsome young Redmond Barry (O'Neal) seeks his fortune as a soldier in Prussia, as a spy then as a gambler living among the elite of Europe. He changes his name and marries an aristocrat (Berenson) for her wealth, but the acceptance he seeks finally eludes him.

programme.title: The Mentalist S5 15
programme.desc: Jane and the CBI team investigate the murder of elderly heiress Elise Vogelson (guest star MARIETTE HARTLEY), whose remains are found in the living room of her spooky mansion.

programme.title: The Mentalist S5 16
programme.desc: Lorelei Martins returns, determined to find out if Red John had a role in her sister's death, and Jane is forced to confess to Lisbon his part in Lorelei's prison escape.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside us, it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In Billy Batson’s (Asher Angel) case, by shouting out one word—SHAZAM!—this streetwise 14-year-old foster kid can turn into the adult Super Hero Shazam (Zachary Levi), courtesy of an ancient wizard (Djimon Hounsou). Still a kid at heart—inside a ripped, godlike body—Shazam revels in this adult version of himself by doing what any teen would do with superpowers: have fun with them! Can he fly? Does he have X-ray vision? Can he shoot lightning out of his hands? Can he skip his social studies test? Shazam sets out to test the limits of his abilities with the joyful recklessness of a child. But he’ll need to master these powers quickly in order to fight the deadly forces of evil controlled by Dr. Thaddeus Sivana (Mark Strong).

programme.title: Collateral Damage
programme.desc: Firefighter Gordon Brewer, is done putting out fires and ready to start one of his own. When his wife and child are horrifically killed in an international terrorist bombing -- linked to Claudio \"The Wolf\" Perrini -- the CIA and FBI offer no answers and no response. With the official investigation going nowhere, and haunted by the thought of his family's killer walking away scot-free, Gordon swears revenge, even if it takes him to Colombia.

programme.title: Journey To The Center Of The Earth
programme.desc: During a scientific expedition to Iceland, scientist Trevor Anderson (Fraser-- Crash, The Mummy), his nephew Sean (Josh Hutcherson) and their local guide, Hannah (Anita Briem), are trapped in a cave -- from which their only escape is to go deeper, into unimagined worlds, where the trio comes face to face with never-before-seen creatures and harrowing dangers as they race an building volcanic eruption to reach the surface!

programme.title: Insidious: Chapter 3
programme.desc: Prekuel yang berlatar sebelum peristiwa yang menghantui keluarga Lambert. Film ini mengungkap alasan mengapa Elise Rainier, paranormal nan berbakat, enggan menggunakan kemampuannya untuk membantu seorang gadis remaja.

programme.title: Ultraviolet
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah tentang seorang mutan genetik nan cantik yang menguasai seni bela diri dalam melindungi ras barunya, serta seorang anak laki-laki nan misterius.

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: Setelah sang ayah wafat, Britt Reid mewarisi perusahaan ayahnya. Ia bekerja sama dengan mantan asisten sang ayah, Kato, untuk menjadi tim pemberantas kejahatan bertopeng.

programme.title: Ultraviolet
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah tentang seorang mutan genetik nan cantik yang menguasai seni bela diri dalam melindungi ras barunya, serta seorang anak laki-laki nan misterius.

programme.title: Hancock
programme.desc: Seorang superhero tiba di Sheepshead Bay, Brooklyn, dan mencoba untuk mewarnai kehidupannya dengan merayu seorang ibu rumah tangga yang memikat. Namun hal ini justru menyebabkan kekacauan di kota itu.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Seorang mantan ahli hewan militer turun tangan saat suatu taman hiburan yang berisi sekawanan dinosaurus hasil rekayasa genetika berubah mengerikan bagi para wisatawan karena salah satu dinosaurus lepas dari kandang.

programme.title: Captain Phillips
programme.desc: Kapal Maersk Alabama yang tengah menuju Kenya dibajak oleh sekelompok perompak Somalia yang dipimpin oleh Abduwali Muse. Namun tak lama kemudian, Muse dan kapten kapal tersebut terjebak dalam situasi nan ekstrem.

programme.title: Salt
programme.desc: Seorang agen CIA terpaksa menjadi buronan setelah seorang pembelot menuduhnya sebagai mata-mata Rusia.

programme.title: Dragonheart: The Heartfire
programme.desc: Drago, seekor naga yang berbagi jiwa dengan raja Brittania, harus menemukan seorang pewaris saat sang raja meninggal. Namun, para calon pewaris menggunakan kekuatan naga dan api mereka untuk melawan satu sama lain.

programme.title: Passengers
programme.desc: Sebuah pesawat ruang angkasa mengalami kerusakan di beberapa kapsul tidurnya kala mengangkut ribuan orang menuju sebuah planet koloni nan jauh. Alhasil, dua penumpang pun terbangun 90 tahun lebih awal.

programme.title: The Man With The Iron Fists
programme.desc: Saat berburu harta karun emas, sekelompok prajurit, pembunuh, dan seorang pembelot asal Inggris pergi ke sebuah desa di Tiongkok dan bertemu seorang pandai besi baik hati yang tengah berjuang mempertahankan desanya.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgement Day
programme.desc: Sesosok siborg nan identik dengan siborg yang gagal membunuh Sarah Connor kini harus melindungi putranya yang berusia sepuluh tahun, John, dari siborg lain yang lebih canggih dan kuat.

programme.title: Gangs Of New York
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1863, Amsterdam Vallon kembali ke area Five Points di Kota New York untuk membalas dendam pada Bill The Butcher yang telah membunuh ayahnya.

programme.title: Hancock

programme.title: Elysium

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: Will dan Jake Grimm menyamar sebagai pengusir setan yang selalu berpindah tempat. Mereka lalu mendapati sebuah kutukan dunia dongeng yang menuntut keberanian sejati, bukan ritual palsu yang biasa mereka lakukan.

programme.title: Collateral

programme.title: Miami Vice
programme.desc: Ketika detektif Ricardo Tubbs dan Sonny Crockett diminta untuk menyelidiki pembunuhan brutal dua agen federal, mereka mendapati diri mereka tertarik ke dalam dunia pengedar narkoba nan memikat dan mematikan.

programme.title: Anacondas: Hunt For Blood...
programme.desc: Sekelompok ilmuwan menerjang bahaya yang ada di hutan hujan untuk mencari bunga yang mengandung serum awet muda.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Tim NCIS harus mengungkap kebenaran dan mewujudkan keajaiban Natal sebelum sebuah biografi seorang Marinir dijual, serta mengubah kisah kepahlawanan sang Marinir menjadi bencana yang akan merusak hari Natalnya.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Tim NCIS mendapati bahwa ternyata pemilik toko roti favorit Parker tengah diperas. Mereka pun menyusun sebuah rencana untuk menyelamatkannya.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Tim NCIS menggelar sebuah pernikahan palsu untuk dua anggotanya sendiri dalam upaya menjatuhkan sekelompok mafia.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Tim NCIS menyelidiki sebuah kasus keracunan fatal yang menimpa salah satu ilmuwan forensik Kasie. Sementara itu, McGee diinterogasi oleh Pentagon mengenai isi bukunya.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Tim NCIS menyelidiki kasus kematian seorang letnan Angkatan Laut di sebuah bank darah. Di sisi lain, McGee mencari dukungan tim untuk penggalangan dana di sekolah anak kembarnya.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Putri Jimmy menemukan sekantong uang dan menyerahkannya kepada Torres. Mereka menemukan bahwa uang tersebut ternyata berasal dari sebuah bank yang dirampok 15 tahun yang lalu.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Usai kematian seorang Letnan Angkatan Laut, Torres dan Knight berhasil mengungkap kasus pembunuhan yang terkait ke sebuah keluarga kaya. Sementara itu, Parker menemukan keterkaitan antara kematian ibunya dengan Lily.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Sebuah acara khusus wanita berubah menjadi kacau saat tim NCIS dipanggil untuk menyelidiki motif seorang pelaku pembakaran. Selain itu, Torres berusaha untuk menemukan keseimbangan antara pekerjaan dan kehidupannya.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Tim NCIS bergegas untuk mengungkap dalang yang memerintahkan pembunuhan terhadap Kepala Angkatan Laut setelah mereka berhasil menangkap seorang pembunuh bayaran yang dikenal sebagai The Poet.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Saat tiga anggota veteran ditemukan tewas terbunuh di kamar motel di D.C., tim NCIS melacak seorang tersangka yang menolak untuk berbicara dengan siapa pun kecuali Sam Hanna.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Karier dan kredibilitas McGee dipertaruhkan saat ia menyelidiki sebuah kasus korupsi yang melibatkan wakil direktur. Di sisi lain, Torres dan Knight menerima beberapa kabar nan mengejutkan.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Saat tim NCIS menyelidiki hubungan berbahaya antara kartel Nexus dan musuh lama Parker, bos mafia Carla Marino, tim menguak sebuah rencana mematikan yang melibatkan bahan nuklir hasil curian.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Tim NCIS mencari seorang agen mata-mata yang hilang di tengah situasi penyanderaan yang sedang berlangsung.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Saat Vance bersiap untuk menggelar diskusi diplomatik dengan Venezuela, tim ditugaskan untuk menyelidiki jenazah salah satu anak buahnya.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Tim NCIS dikerahkan untuk penyelidikan saat seorang letnan pulang ke rumah pada Malam Halloween, lalu mendapati terdapat sebuah pesta kejutan yang diadakan untuk orang lain di rumahnya.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Tim NCIS ditugaskan untuk menetralisasi bahaya setelah menerima informasi intelijen tentang sejumlah ancaman nan mematikan di berbagai lokasi yang dapat memicu perang besar.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Tim NCIS bekerja sama dengan CIA untuk menemukan sejumlah rahasia yang disembunyikan oleh seorang mantan mata-mata yang sudah tua dan menderita demensia bernama Kapten Butler.

programme.desc: Situasi berubah menjadi menegangkan saat Knight ditugaskan untuk melindungi istrinya setelah rumah seorang kontraktor pertahanan tingkat tinggi diserang.

programme.title: Rocky IV
programme.desc: Rocky trains his friend Apollo Creed for a match against Ivan Drago, an indestructible Russian boxer. However, when Apollo dies in the ring, Rocky vows to avenge his death.

programme.title: The Suicide Squad
programme.desc: A group of misfits are coerced to work together for a dangerous mission in Corto Maltese. Despite their differences, they learn to trust each other and collaborate as a team.

programme.title: Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance
programme.desc: A French monk seeks out the Ghost Rider, a superpowered antihero, for help in protecting a young boy who is being pursued by the Devil and his minions.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: After Set, the Egyptian God of darkness, kills his brother and seizes the throne, he enslaves the kingdom. However, a flawed mortal, Bek, and the God of the sky Horus rise to challenge him.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: After being abandoned at a fair, Billy constantly searches for his mother. His life, however, takes a huge turn when he inherits superpowers from a powerful wizard.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: During the Cybertron Civil War, Optimus Prime sends Autobot scout B-127 to Earth to form a base where they can regroup. Later, the scout befriends a girl named Charlie, who names him Bumblebee.

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: Detective James Carter and Chief Inspector Lee return to action after a bomb explosion at the US Embassy in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Extinction
programme.desc: During a zombie apocalypse engineered by the Umbrella Corporation, Alice and a group of survivors journey across the country in search of supplies and a safe place.

programme.title: Barely Lethal
programme.desc: Megan Walsh, a special agent, is curious about teenage life experiences so she fakes her own death and enrols in high school. Soon, she realises the troubles of the high school life.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas, a young man, trains under an elder in order to become the keeper of his community's memories. However, things get complicated once he discovers the sinister side of his city.

programme.title: Stars!
programme.desc: The host sheds light on various popular individuals from different walks of life and highlights their individual journeys to stardom.

programme.title: The Kidnapping of Freddy Heineken
programme.desc: A gang of childhood friends make a plan to abduct one of the richest men on the earth and demand the largest ransom ever paid for any kidnapping.

programme.title: Giallo
programme.desc: In Italy, a woman fears her sister has been kidnapped; Inspector Enzo Avolfi fears it's worse. They team up to rescue her from a sadistic killer known only as Yellow.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: A prosecutor commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man.

programme.title: Barely Lethal
programme.desc: Megan Walsh, a special agent, is curious about teenage life experiences so she fakes her own death and enrols in high school. Soon, she realises the troubles of the high school life.

programme.title: The LEGO Movie
programme.desc: Emmet, an ordinary individual prophesied to be the Special, is entrusted with the responsibility of saving the Lego world from the cruel ways of Lord Business.
